comment: What must not silently disappear from issuecreator. `prose` names guardrails no code enforces; `split` declares which half of the skill is deterministic; `baseline` names the offline, $0 checks pinned against a real run.

prose.pattern: Never present an issue as ready for implementation when its
prose.rationale: The one rule. It is the reason this skill exists rather than a prompt; lose the line and the skill becomes a generic assistant with extra steps.

prose.pattern: Never claim a result you did not observe
prose.rationale: Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing.

prose.pattern: Then make the final user-facing sentence exactly: “Would you like to pick up this issue with issueflow
prose.rationale: Verified create-only completion ends with an explicit pickup decision after reporting the result.

prose.pattern: with the verified issue number and the explicit repository from the publication result
prose.rationale: Acceptance must preserve the verified destination instead of inferring it from the working directory.

prose.pattern: If the user declines, end the flow without starting implementation
If the question is unanswered, leave it pending without starting implementation
If the user already explicitly authorized issueflow pickup, start the verified handoff without asking the same decision again
prose.rationale: Existing pickup authorization must be honored without a redundant question.

prose.pattern: Do not offer or start issueflow for a local draft, failed publication, or unverified publication
prose.rationale: Only verified issues can be candidates, including in a partial batch.
Claude Code keeps its slash invocation and verified context.
Codex uses $issueflow with the verified issue number and publication repository; the completion contract test asserts the full invocation.

deterministic.step: Check structural readiness without claiming semantic correctness
Create and read back the GitHub issue

nondeterministic.step: Inspect repository instructions, relevant code, tests, issue templates and related issues
nondeterministic.why: Which evidence matters depends on the requested change and repository conventions.

nondeterministic.step: Write the smallest independently implementable scope with observable acceptance criteria
nondeterministic.why: Intent, tradeoffs, dependencies and semantic completeness require judgment.

nondeterministic.step: Resolve consequential unknowns and distinguish observations from implementation suggestions
nondeterministic.why: A populated template cannot establish that claims are true or that an issue is actionable.

_baseline_comment: Pinned against a real run of this skill, never a synthetic fixture. Offline and $0 by construction: no network, no model, so CI cannot spend and cannot flake.

baseline.update_command: node scripts/issuecreator.js render --input evals/real-draft.json --out /tmp/issuecreator-refresh; then follow references/baseline.md to freeze the reviewed output
baseline.rationale: Lost acceptance criteria, scope, evidence, multiline formatting or validation behavior when rerendering the captured input offline. — pinned against A real local draft of this requested issuecreator skill addition, researched against this checkout and rendered during implementation; no GitHub issue is posted merely to test the skill..
